title: Comparisons from two model structures agree through common replacements
statement: Use quasicategories, coherent functors, natural equivalences and mapping spaces of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and simplicial model categories, bifibrant objects and coherent nerves of [lem-coef-simplicial-model-nerve-localization]. Work in nested universes containing all the categories below. Let $\mathcal D$ be a simplicially enriched category with two simplicial model structures $\mathcal D_p,\mathcal D_q$ on the same underlying category, with the same enrichment and the same weak equivalences $W$. Let $P,Q$ be the full simplicial subcategories of objects bifibrant for the respective structures, and let $E\subseteq\mathcal D$ be a full simplicial subcategory containing both $P$ and $Q$. Write $P_0,Q_0,E_0$ for their underlying ordinary categories. Suppose there is an ordinary functor $R:Q_0\to P_0$ and an ordinary natural transformation $c:\iota_P R\Rightarrow\iota_Q$ in $E_0$, where $\iota_P,\iota_Q$ are the inclusions, with every $c_G$ in $W$. Let $\mathcal T$ be a quasicategory and $e:N_{\mathrm{hc}}E\to\mathcal T$ a simplicial map sending every edge arising from a morphism of $W$ in $E_0$ to an equivalence. Let $e_p,e_q$ be its restrictions to $N_{\mathrm{hc}}P,N_{\mathrm{hc}}Q$. Let $\mathcal L=N(\mathcal D)[W^{-1}]_\infty$, let $\psi_p:N_{\mathrm{hc}}P\simeq\mathcal L$ and $\psi_q:N_{\mathrm{hc}}Q\simeq\mathcal L$ be the localization comparisons agreeing with inclusion on the ordinary nerves, and put $\Phi=\psi_p^{-1}\psi_q$. Then there is a coherent natural equivalence $e_q\simeq e_p\Phi$. In particular, if $e_p$ is an equivalence of quasicategories, so is $e_q$.
